results.title: Occupied
results.overview: A club toilet becomes the stage for queer encounters, connection, and community.

results.title: Föa - Once Upon A Future
results.original_title: Föa - C'era una volta il futuro
results.overview: Nicole, alone at home while pregnant during the G8 demonstrations in Genoa, unwisely opens the door to a group of protesters. During the forced cohabitation, the private world of the woman and the public world of the boys collide and end up changing each other.

results.title: Bread and Games
results.overview: Ferdinand rents a cellar for 200 euros a month. But that’s still too much. The arrival of the Olympic Games in Paris makes him dream big, but he only gets a temporary job at the Stade de France and gets swallowed up by the noise and fury of the Games. At night, Ferdinand learns to write songs with his best friend Juliette and turns his cramped cellar into a place of comfort.

results.title: Human Theories
results.overview: Through forty interconnected vignettes, Human Theories is a comedic kaleidoscope exploring how people try, and often fail, to connect with one another in this weird world. Filmed over a year on location in New York City with a diverse ensemble cast of over 50 actors and non-actors, the film is an experimental love letter to the awkward struggle of modern city living.

results.title: Contention
results.overview: Siblings are taken hostage by a young girl with mysterious abilities. However, their captor is on the run from a cunning man who is hellbent on returning the girl to her prison.

results.title: LURK
results.overview: Man-animal conflict, exploring who the real predator is, man or animal, with inspiration from real incidents and forest life.

results.title: Es frisst
results.overview: After a botched robbery, a young gangster couple takes a mother and her daughter hostage and ends up in a forgotten forest cemetery on the edge of a disused industrial estate.

results.title: Absolutely Devoted to You
results.overview: An ambitious TV producer devises a brilliant plan to reunite a 90's boy band for an annual summer beach bash, but her idea is derailed when she falls for the band's reluctant lead singer.

results.title: Still Form
results.overview: A model is being sculpted. Experiments in time and space.

results.title: I Am the Prize
results.overview: A polarizing self-help figure, whose carefully constructed identity begins to unravel during the height of a lecture tour.

results.title: Into the Forest
results.overview: In a quiet stop-motion studio, a small monkey opens its eyes. Everything around it feels frozen. On a computer screen, a luminous jungle appears, distant, almost alive. With two companions, he sets out to create one of their own, using whatever they can find. A forest shaped by imagination, their only way out.

results.title: Masud Rana
results.overview: Based on Qazi Anwar Hussain's novel series Masud Rana aka MR-9.

results.title: Every Breath We Take
results.original_title: O Ar Que a Gente Respira
results.overview: A murder investigation in a small rural town, marked by silences and loyalties, uncovers old secrets. Adoniran, a respected investigator, sees his life collapse when he goes from agent to prime suspect. While trying to prove his innocence, Saulo, Special Agent of Internal Affairs, returns to his hometown and must confront memories he would rather forget. Inner conflicts, fragile alliances, and unresolved recollections make the search for truth increasingly dangerous.

results.title: Galia
results.overview: After leaving a juvenile rehabilitation center, Galia returns to the place where she spent her childhood to confront her abusive father. Alongside Zeba, her companion, she embarks on a journey that forces her to face a past marked by violence and decide how far she is willing to go to break free from it.

results.title: Mighty Mary
results.overview: Mighty Mary chronicles an amazing group of “we eat nails for breakfast” type of women: the first all-women’s sailing team to contend for the famed America’s Cup, the holy grail for one of sport’s most elite and exclusive racing events.  This team was groundbreaking, beginning with an advertisement in the New York Times.  From there, a group of world class and Olympic sailors as well as Olympic rowers came together, a team which included a deaf sailor, a Native Hawaiian sailor, and the first African American sailor to ever win an America’s Cup race (as a coach of this novice, erstwhile team).  What was dismissed as a publicity stunt turned into something unimaginable. This motley crew (sailing aboard Mighty Mary) stunningly eliminated Stars & Stripes from contention. However, a secret backroom deal the night before the race upended that result. This is a true underdog story about a team which reshaped what could be possible in a sport that had long been inaccessible.

results.title: How to Live on Earth
results.overview: A visionary feature documentary that explores our vital connection to nature and its role in our future. Presented by Benedict Cumberbatch, this ultimate 'how-to guide' features inspirational, cutting-edge stories and powerful cinematography from around the world to reveal how humans are learning to team up with nature to solve our biggest challenges.

results.title: Pierre-Yves prend le métro
results.overview: In an immersive quest through the Montreal Metro, Pierre-Yves Lord dives into the history, hidden spots, and key highlights of one of North America’s largest metro systems.

results.title: 77 Hours
results.overview: 77 Hours is a psychological thriller and political drama set across the nights of January 8 and 9, when Iran's streets become the scene of one of the darkest and bloodiest crackdowns in recent memory.  Unarmed and unprepared, ordinary people are trapped in chaos, gunfire, fear, and death. At the center is a man who is not a hero prepared for battle, but an ordinary person forced to survive in an inhuman catastrophe — surrounded by wounded civilians, security forces, and collapsing memories.  Through a tense, intimate narrative moving between streets, hospital corridors, hidden spaces, and broken recollections, the film explores survival, sacrifice, guilt, silence, and the fragile line between truth and fear.
